items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: Poise played guitar, banjo, now he's playing piano.

ctx.x: They came off Rabbit Foot, I think they came from the Rabbit Foot Show in here. Douglas and the trumpet players. Both of them were trumpet players. He was trumpet players but now he's playing bass for Otis and Vildplatt. Poise played guitar, banjo, now he's playing piano. He has another boy, you know, just got one arm. He's trumpet player too. Now he's doubling on trumpet and trombone.
We play trombone with one arm.
